name: policy-pack
title: Controlled policy pack
for_each: select id,name from policies where not archived

sections.title: Current policy
sections.sql: select p.name,p.category,o.name as owner,r.version,r.body,r.effective_on from policies p join people o on o.id=p.owner_id left join revisions r on r.policy_id=p.id and r.status='effective' where p.id=$1

sections.title: Decision evidence
sections.sql: select r.version,a.decision,pe.name as approver,a.decided_on,a.evidence from revisions r join approvals a on a.revision_id=r.id join people pe on pe.id=a.approver_id where r.policy_id=$1 order by r.version

sections.title: Review notes
sections.sql: select body,author,created_at from notes where policy_id=$1 order by created_at

name: attestation-register
title: Policy acknowledgement register
for_each: select id,name from policies where not archived

sections.title: Version-specific acknowledgement evidence
sections.sql: select v.policy,v.version,v.version_status,v.person,v.department,v.due_on,v.acknowledged_on,v.evidence from v_acknowledgements v join assignments a on a.id=v.id join revisions r on r.id=a.revision_id where r.policy_id=$1 order by v.version,v.person
sections.note: Recorded by an operator from external evidence. This is not an electronic signature service.

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.sql: select name,reason,expires_on,status,resolution from exceptions where policy_id=$1 order by expires_on
